title: The Canonical Society Theorem
description:
After a person leaves a job, how does life continue, who bears the outstanding responsibilities, and how does the institution obtain the conditions for its next action? Given explicit sources of activity, lineage rules, and a complete responsibility contract, we construct a family of inhabited canonical societies and prove that actor generation, root-law completeness, genuine exit, and regeneration at every depth can be realized together. Every complete installed execution receives presentation, refusal that retains the bearer, action, or revision grounded in exact failure; writing occurs if and only if the disposition is action or revision. Exhaustiveness for general executions and inhabited realization at one constitutional point are proved separately. “Canonical” has its mathematical meaning: a standard construction generated from specified data and rules, with explicit compatibility relations.

The main results cover continued operation. At every natural-number depth, the same actual payment jointly carries six guarantees: continuation of law and lineage, noncontracting exit, repair of capture, retention and processing of the residual bearer, revision capacity at the successor, and responsibility across actors. The visit it actually reaches is the entry to the next depth. More strongly, take any payment cycle of the defined type, any position in it, and any lawful payment at that position. The complete institutional contract enters that payment's actual target, where the target's own payment fulfills a new service or exit occurrence. The entire set of earlier paid occurrences is retained, and the new occurrence lies outside their authority image. Instantaneous exit capacity can therefore remain one throughout while the frontier of fulfilled occurrences grows strictly. Beyond every finite cutoff, the same later step also jointly generates actual law revision and a new birth supported by payment.

The negative results show why these conditions cannot be omitted. Missing payment incidence, an interrupted route, and captured continuation can all produce zero exit capacity. Two sources with capacity one can likewise possess and lack, respectively, a complete portfolio of capabilities for living. In the constructed source family, even reachability readings for every domain are insufficient to choose an exact repair, and every method that processes only those readings inherits the obstruction. Retaining the already available failure kind restores each source's uniquely effective repair. Finally, old responsibility is transported through law revision until its own fulfillment settles it. For an exhausted source ledger, every sequential target from the same source that adds no rows at entry and increases no row's budget has no positive progress budget at its first whole-ledger successor. Institutional continuation thus has two requirements: every exercise of power must account for its bearers and consequences, and every new possibility must obtain its own actual source.

additional_descriptions.description:
一个人离开岗位以后，生活怎样继续，旧责任由谁承担，制度又怎样取得下一次行动的条件？本文在明确给定的活动来源、谱系规则与完整责任合同下，构造一族非空的典范社会，证明主体生成、根法完备、真实退出与全深度续生能够共同实现。每次完整安装执行都取得呈现、保留承担者的拒绝、行动或有精确失败依据的修订；写入当且仅当行动或修订。一般执行的穷尽性与同一宪制点的非空实现分别得到证明。“典范”取数学中 canonical 的含义：依给定数据与规则生成，并具有明确相容关系的标准构造。

主结果覆盖持续运行。在每个自然数深度，同一次实际支付共同承担法与谱系续接、退出不收缩、捕获修复、残差承担者及其处理、后继修订能力和跨主体责任六项保证；它真正到达的访问就是下一深度的入口。更强地，任取所定义类型中的支付周期、其中位置和该处合规付款，完整制度合同都进入这笔付款的真实目标，并在那里由目标自身的支付兑现新的服务或退出发生。整个旧的已付发生集合被保留，新发生处于其权威像之外。因此，瞬时退出容量可以始终为一，已经兑现的发生前沿却严格增长。任意有限截点之后，同一个后来步骤还会共同生成实际修法与有支付支持的新生。

反面结果揭示这些条件为何不可省略。支付关联缺失、通路中断和继续能力被捕获，都可产生零退出容量；两个容量同为一的来源，也可分别具有和缺失完整的生活能力组合。在所构造的来源族中，连全部领域的可达读出也不足以选择精确修复，任何只处理这些读数的方法都继承这一障碍；保留事先已有的失败种类，则恢复各自唯一有效的修复。最后，旧责任沿改法迁移，直到自己的履行使其结清；对已耗尽源账的全部入口无新行、逐行预算不增的同源顺序目标，首次整账后继均无正进展预算。制度的继续由此具有双重要求：每次权力行使交代承担者和后果，每次新增可能性取得自己的实际来源。

Version 2 revises the bilingual main paper for continuity, institutional interpretation, and scholarly dialogue. The technical supplements and the complete formal-proof scope retain their accepted identities. English and Chinese manuscripts and technical supplements, plus editable source.
